label: Object Extraction
description: Generic vision prompt for extracting meaningful objects and relations from an image or grid.
text: Describe the current visual state comprehensively but nonredundantly.

Detect meaningful connected color regions and useful structures such as blocks, rectangles, bars, line segments, glyphs, holes, enclosures, borders, status indicators, compound objects, and meaningful sub-objects.
Do not treat every individual cell or pixel as a separate object unless it has an independent semantic role.
Preserve exact topology, connectivity, cavities, holes, borders, containment, adjacency, and overlap relationships rather than replacing irregular geometry with oversized rectangles.
